eyebrow: A strategy is a deterministic function
code:
def strategy(prices_to_t):
    # only data available
    # at or before time t
    lb = 20
    sig = prices_to_t.pct_change(lb)
    sig = sig.iloc[-1]
    return 1.0 if sig > 0 else -1.0
caption: Same inputs, same output, every time — that's what makes it backtestable.
